cli.description: X-Port — extract from chat archives (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Claude Code, our graph, text files). Zero network by default; sources are never modified.
cli.opt.aggregate: aggregate mode: counts only, no titles, text or file names
cli.opt.sources: archives, directories or files (format sniffed from content)
cli.opt.package: package directory to write (inventory, timeline, selection, manifest, report)
cli.opt.save_recipe: save the normalised recipe to a file
cli.opt.terms: keywords (PL inflection and diacritic folding; /regex/ is a regex)
cli.opt.criteria: criteria: preset id (e.g. chatadhd) or JSON file
cli.opt.like: more like this: similarity to the given units
cli.opt.expand: neighbourhood: none | window:N | branch | conversation | conversation+linked | time_window:P
cli.opt.cascade: cascade: default | recall_first | precision_first | lexical_only | vectors_only
cli.opt.mode: how to combine with the current selection
cli.opt.since: previous export or package: compute the diff (what is new)
cli.opt.only: restrict the selection to the diff result (only_new | changed | removed | all)
cli.opt.model: enable model levels of the cascade (this slice: count and estimate only, no calls)
cli.opt.key: timeline key: created | updated | first_message | last_message | activity
cli.opt.gap: gap in days (0 = do not report)
cli.opt.burst: burst: multiple of the median (0 = do not report)
cli.opt.anonymise: relative axis: gaps kept, epoch zeroed
cli.opt.no_continuations: do not look for cross-service continuations
cli.opt.unit: unit identifier (uid, its prefix or the external id)
cli.opt.files: files to sniff (without files: list known formats)
cli.verb.inventory: Inventory: what the archives contain (measured, never guessed)
cli.verb.timeline: Global timeline across all archives and services
cli.verb.diff: Diff: what is new since the previous export
cli.verb.search: Search and select: words, regexes, criteria, expressions, patterns, similarity; dry run or to a package
cli.verb.explain: Explain why a unit was included or not
cli.verb.mark: Manual decision (stored in decisions.json; wins over the cascade)
cli.verb.clusters: Discover topic clusters (other small projects) without a model
cli.verb.formats: Known formats or recognition of the given files
cli.inventory.absent: What the formats do not contain: {n} entries (inventory.json → absent)
cli.search.model_note: model levels counted, not called (no network); calls arrive in slice B
cli.search.dry: Would include: conversations {conversations}, messages {messages}, attachments {attachments} (missing {missing}), ~{tokens} tokens, ~{bytes} B
cli.mark.usage: Give a UID and a decision (include | exclude | ambiguous | remove), or --list, or --proposals SOURCES
cli.mark.proposals: Proposals: {n} (from {corrections} corrections) — stored in decisions.json → proposals; nothing applied
report.title: Extract report (X-Port)
report.shadow: Shadow channel: lexical only {lexical_only}, vectors only {vectors_only}, both {both}
report.timeline_line: Key {key}: {rows} rows; gaps {gaps}, bursts {bursts}, cross-service continuations {continuations} (inferred, not merged)
report.unknown_blocks: unknown blocks: {n} ({kinds}) — kept in the 'unknown' bucket with an example
report.absent: What the formats do not contain
report.model_pending: Model levels waiting (grains): {flows} — enable explicitly (--model), cost shown before sending
report.how_to_resolve: How to resolve: `mark --decisions decisions.json UID include|exclude` or `--model`.
report.reproduce_line: `recipe run recipe.json` from this package ({steps} steps); `manifest.json` → reproducible_hash.
cards.no_summary: no summary (only with --model and the summarize flow)
cli.check.handoff: hand-off import through engine.importer: {conversations} conversations, {messages_with_text} messages with text
cli.check.ok: Package valid: {outputs} files match the manifest
cli.cost.line: Estimate of the paid steps: {calls} call(s), cost {amount} {currency}
cli.cost.question: Model steps: {calls} call(s), estimate {amount}. The default answer is no.
cli.cost.x10: Note: the estimate {amount} is more than {ratio}× the last accepted run ({last}). Confirm separately.
cli.cut.attachments: attachments: {referenced} referenced, {copied} copied, {missing} missing (listed in the report)
cli.cut.preserve: source format 1:1: {conversations} conversations, {copied} attachments, {missing} missing, byte-exact: {exact}
cli.describe.no_overlay: the app data directory is unknown (set --data-dir or CHATADHD_DATA), so there is nowhere to save
cli.edit.preview_only: preview — nothing changed ({patch} change(s) in the diff); without --preview the edit goes into the package
cli.handoff.line: Hand-off: {conversations} conversations, {messages} messages ({text} with text), {attachments} attachments
cli.interrupted: interrupted — run the same command to start again (the model cache stays)
cli.opt.accept_x10: confirm an estimate above ×10 of the last run (guard)
cli.opt.branches: branches in the hand-off: current (preset), newest, longest, marked, tree
cli.opt.cheap_model: model for the 'cheap' class (never inherited from the chat)
cli.opt.edit_op: edit operation (data/edits: set, replace_regex, flatten, merge_conversations, …)
cli.opt.handoff: add the hand-off package for the app's importer (handoff/ + handoff.zip)
cli.opt.manifest: the package's manifest.json (or the package directory)
cli.opt.order: conversation order in the package: created (preset), updated, title, source_order, package
cli.opt.out_zone: time zone in outputs (source = untouched, preset)
cli.opt.param: operation parameter k=v (JSON value or text)
cli.opt.plan: show the steps and the cost estimate, write nothing
cli.opt.profile: profile (data/profiles: preserve, flat, structure, reasoning, text, graph, table, timeline, cards, bundle); repeatable
cli.opt.provider_url: OpenAI-compatible provider URL (…/v1); key from LOOM_EXTRACT_API_KEY or secrets.json
cli.opt.redaction: redaction profile (data/redaction: none, personal, secrets, dictionary)
cli.opt.replay_only: model steps from the cache only (no calls)
cli.opt.save_criteria: save the criteria under this name in the user overlay
cli.opt.saved_filter: a saved filter (filter save NAME EXPR)
cli.opt.summaries: model summaries of conversations (cards; only with --model)
cli.opt.time_format: time format: iso8601 (preset), epoch, date, source
cli.opt.topic: topic (a criteria id from data/criteria or a word/phrase)
cli.opt.where: scope: a selection-language expression, e.g. message[role:tool]
cli.opt.yes: accept the cost estimate without asking
cli.sentence.no_sources: the sentence names no archive ('from archive FILE')
cli.sentence.rest: not understood: “{rest}” (skipped; rephrase or use a verb)
cli.verb.attachments: Attachments browser: references, resolved, missing, by type, size, conversation
cli.verb.check: Check a package: hashes, manifest, recipe, hand-off import
cli.verb.cost: Cost estimate of the model steps (no calls)
cli.verb.cut: Cut: select the topic and write the package (source format 1:1, restructuring profiles, manifest, report)
cli.verb.describe: A description in words → criteria (no model: grammar; with --model: the flow)
cli.verb.edit: Batch edit of a package (diff preview, applied to the copy, recorded in the recipe)
cli.verb.flow: Flows and cascades: list, show, check
cli.verb.handoff: Hand-off package for the app's importer
cli.verb.reproduce: Reproduce a package from its manifest and compare byte for byte
cli.verb.stats: Package statistics per conversation and overall, topic timeline
report.cut_branches: branches cut: {n} ({m} messages off the kept path; a note in each conversation)
report.cut_omitted_count: {archive}: {n} member(s) left out (names outside aggregate mode)
report.cut_indivisible: {member}: copied whole (no conversation boundaries in the format), also holds {n} other conversation(s)
report.cut_partial: {n} conversation(s) selected partially — the source format holds them whole
report.handoff_line: {conversations} conversations, {messages} messages ({text} with text), {attachments} attachments, {missing} missing; import: handoff.zip or handoff/
report.masked_line: profile {profile}: {n} occurrence(s) masked ({kinds}); the values are written nowhere
report.masked_attachments: binary attachments are not redacted (copied unchanged)
report.cost_flow: {flow} ({model}): {calls} call(s), {cache} from the cache, tokens {tin}/{tout}, cost {amount}
report.reproduce_manifest: Or: `reproduce manifest.json` — builds the package next to it and compares reproducible_hash.
cli.opt.attachment_text: embed the text of text attachments (txt, md, csv, json, code) in outputs; images and audio need OCR/ASR (not in this slice)
